interpretation: Zero rereading of the cached prefix during each timed append. New prompt tokens still undergo prefill.

cache_policy.primers: Five original cold-prefix requests, once each; native state snapshot at exact D after its unscored one-token prediction
cache_policy.appends: Native GEN bench_reuse=D requires exact cached prefix. Reject before prefill if unavailable; no fallback.
cache_policy.new_tokens: Exactly P=512/2048/4096. Native reused must equal D and prompt_read must equal P.
cache_policy.history: Retain expert placement and lookup history after the required single warmup. Cold resets invalidate conversation state only.
cache_policy.snapshot_timing: No generation or prefix replay. Pin receipt and wall time retained outside timed append and cold-primer request.
cache_policy.benchmark_target: Separate target from pinned canonical source; native checkpoint save/restore unchanged; normal model math unchanged

original_payloads: All original 24 request bodies preserved, except model alias. Cached depth is an adapter header/native cache guard, not a sampler change.

prior_attempt.reason: Periodic checkpoint replay was observed; retain all first outputs and timings as diagnostic.

historical_cache_limitation: Carlos metrics show 96337 generated tokens before its recorded warmup; earlier resident ngram history is not reproducible from this counting archive. New v5 starts with a fresh lookup state and the same recorded warmup; historical Carlos cannot supply a fully controlled warmed-cache ranking.
